metadata.title: AI Coding Agents Execution Sandbox - Sources
metadata.description: Official documentation and implementation references for sandboxing, process isolation, filesystem policy, network controls, and execution safety in coding-agent runtimes

official_documentation.name: Claude Code Documentation
official_documentation.relevance: Primary product documentation for runtime execution, approvals, and local operating model

official_documentation.name: Claude Code — Configure the sandboxed Bash tool
official_documentation.relevance: Primary source for the shipping Bash sandbox: settings.json keys, mode names, platform backends, credential deny/mask, TLS-blind allowlist caveat, and documented compatibility failures. Fetched and cross-checked 2026-07-11.

official_documentation.name: OpenAI Codex — Sandboxing concept doc
official_documentation.relevance: Primary source for Codex sandbox mode names (read-only/workspace-write/danger-full-access) and the separate approval-policy axis (untrusted/on-request/never). Fetched and cross-checked 2026-07-11.

official_documentation.name: Model Context Protocol Specification
official_documentation.relevance: Reference for tool and server capability boundaries when execution crosses process or transport layers

implementation_references.name: Claude Code GitHub Repository
implementation_references.relevance: Primary implementation reference for sandbox mode, working-directory boundaries, and approval integration

implementation_references.name: Codex CLI Repository
implementation_references.relevance: Cross-runtime comparison point for command execution, approvals, and sandbox boundaries

implementation_references.name: OpenAI Codex Core Sandbox Support Matrix
implementation_references.relevance: Pinned first-party source for macOS Seatbelt, Linux Landlock/bubblewrap, Windows sandbox backend, split policy fallback, and fail-closed behavior

implementation_references.name: OpenAI: Building a safe, effective sandbox to enable Codex on Windows
implementation_references.relevance: May 2026 first-party explanation of sandbox design tradeoffs, useful defaults, full-access risk, and process-tree enforcement

security_references.name: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard
security_references.relevance: Useful security baseline for least privilege, environment separation, and command execution boundaries

security_references.name: OWASP Docker Security Cheat Sheet
security_references.relevance: Practical isolation patterns when coding-agent execution uses containers or microVMs

goose_aaif_references.name: Goose moves to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF)
goose_aaif_references.relevance: April 7, 2026 post documenting transfer of goose from Block to AAIF (Linux Foundation). Repository moved to aaif-goose/goose, documentation to goose-docs.ai.

goose_aaif_references.name: OpenTelemetry GenAI Agent Spans Semantic Conventions
goose_aaif_references.relevance: Experimental OTel spec for gen_ai agent spans: gen_ai.operation.name, gen_ai.agent.name/id/version, tool child spans gen_ai.tool.name / gen_ai.tool.call.id. Relevant to sandbox denial events and agent-span observability.
